select * from ( SELECT r.id id, r.RULE_NAME ruleName, r.REP_NAME repName, r.DETAIL detail, r.BASIS_DATE_TYPE basisDateType, r.FILE_OUT_TYPE fileOutType, r.REVEAL_CHANNEL revealChannel, r.UPDATE_TIME FROM REP_RULE r WHERE 1=1
AND r.REP_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{repName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
AND r.RULE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{ruleName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
order by r.UPDATE_TIME desc ) tmp where 1=1
